note: Set B binds the key controller facts cleanly — the 47,402.91 N·m saturation with its full 10%-above-rated condition, the 1° previous-pitch trigger, the 15,000 N·m/s rate limit, the 1173.7 rpm rated speed, and the important point that no drivetrain-torsional-damping loop was needed — with quotes that actually match the text. Set A covers more items (single-DOF design model, region labels) but adds noise: two saturation claims with a garbled/fabricated quote ('we saturated the torque to a rated, or 47,402.91 N•m'), two Optimal-curve claims with invented bracketed quotes, a misquoted PI claim ('betwee speed… actual speed' instead of filtered generator speed), a vague '10000 unspecified' torque claim, and a trivial 'plotted curve' claim. B does misread the Optimal (black) curve as 20,000 N·m at 850/870 rpm and repeats several chart points, but its errors are fewer and less severe than A's invented quotes and misbindings; A also omits the no-damping-loop fact.
